title: Hasilian Research Snapshot (HRS) No. 4/2026 – Perceptions of Individual Taxpayers Among Tax Administrators Toward Adoption of e-Invoice
summary: HASiL published a new research snapshot on how tax administrators perceive individual taxpayers' adoption of e-Invoice. It is a research publication, not a ruling or guideline, so it does not change any tax treatment; it may be useful background for e-Invoice discussions.
